description: Presidential Secretariat - Declaration of the Services Supply or Distribution of Fuel including Petrolium Products & Gas to be an  essential Public Service
reasoning: This gazette content is a presidential order declaring certain services as essential public services under the Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979. It involves the exercise of statutory powers to create a regulatory framework (declaring services essential), which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters. While it mentions the President by name, it does not involve government personnel changes or detailed portfolio assignments (Types 1-3), but rather establishes a legal/regulatory status for specified services.
